Strong.criterion: Outstanding performance with sufficient evidence of exceeding role expectations

Meets.criterion: Meets role expectations, supported by concrete examples

Below.criterion: Partially meets expectations, with clear gaps

Weak.criterion: Does not meet core role requirements

technical.name: Technical interview
technical.goal: Assess whether the candidate has the technical ability and practical engineering experience required for the role

dimensions.name: Technical foundations and role skills
dimensions.focus: Core technical principles, depth of knowledge, and proficiency in the JD's technology stack

dimensions.name: Project ownership and personal contribution
dimensions.focus: Actual personal contributions, implementation details, technical challenges, project outcomes, and answer consistency

dimensions.name: Architecture and technical judgment
dimensions.focus: System design, technology selection, alternatives, and performance/scalability trade-offs

dimensions.name: Engineering quality and practice
dimensions.focus: Code quality, test coverage, error handling, reliability, and security

dimensions.name: Problem analysis and troubleshooting
dimensions.focus: Fault isolation, hypothesis testing, debugging methods, and solutions

dimensions.name: Technical communication
dimensions.focus: Clarity, logical structure, and handling follow-ups

comprehensive.name: Comprehensive interview
comprehensive.goal: Assess whether the candidate can work independently, deliver projects, and collaborate effectively with a team

dimensions.name: Business and product understanding
dimensions.focus: User needs, business goals, problem definition, and product value

dimensions.name: Decision-making and judgment
dimensions.focus: Prioritization, resource constraints, risk analysis, and trade-offs

dimensions.name: Delivery and ownership
dimensions.focus: Personal responsibilities, delivery outcomes, taking responsibility for problems, and retrospectives

dimensions.name: Cross-team collaboration
dimensions.focus: Team communication, disagreements, cross-functional cooperation, and feedback handling

dimensions.name: Initiative and learning
dimensions.focus: Self-direction, learning speed, adaptability, and continuous improvement

dimensions.name: Structured thinking and communication
dimensions.focus: Structured expression, logical reasoning, complex-problem analysis, and thinking on the spot

hr.name: HR interview
hr.goal: Assess the candidate's motivation, experience credibility, career direction, and alignment with the role

dimensions.name: Motivation
dimensions.focus: Reasons for applying, understanding of the company and role, and interest in the opportunity

dimensions.name: Experience consistency
dimensions.focus: Resume accuracy, consistency of experience, and reasons for leaving or seeking a role

dimensions.name: Teamwork and conflict handling
dimensions.focus: Collaboration, conflict resolution, accepting feedback, and professional behavior

dimensions.name: Growth potential
dimensions.focus: Willingness to learn, self-awareness, growth examples, and adaptability

dimensions.name: Career planning
dimensions.focus: Short- and medium-term goals, career direction, and role alignment

dimensions.name: Professional communication
dimensions.focus: Clarity, communication approach, listening, and responding
